messages:
mel (Docs): FYI: small naming cleanup in docs + SDKs: `timeout_ms` -> `timeout`. Goal is consistent units across languages. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/922

owen (Eng SDK): Are we keeping backward alias?

mel (Docs): Yes, alias in SDKs for 60 days. Server accepts both keys for the same window. Removal planned 2026-05-20.

rachel (Product): We'll announce in next release notes. Can support prepare a short blurb?

support-bot: Template: "Note: param rename `timeout_ms` -> `timeout`. Both supported until 2026-05-20. See migration guide: https://go.redwood.dev/timeout-migration"

sam (DevEx): I'll update examples in quickstarts and add a lint rule to catch `timeout_ms`.
